lines.en: I give Tsubasa a call and get talked into coming over to her manor as she’s unable to leave the premises today for rich person reasons.
lines.zh: 我给 Tsubasa 打了个电话,被她说得晕头转向,只好去她的公馆——因为她今天由于有钱人的种种理由,无法踏出宅邸半步。

lines.en: I guess that’s fine, though. I’m comfortable enough with my commoner lifestyle to not be put off by the overwhelming success of others- even if those people are born into it.
lines.zh: 不过,我觉得那也没什么。我对自己的平民生活方式足够安心,不会被别人压倒性的成功吓退——哪怕那些人是含着金汤匙出生的。

lines.en: Do I think it’s a little unfair? Sure. But Tsubasa, at least so far, seems like a good person. So even if she wasn’t born into a wealthy family, I’m sure she would have figured it out so far.
lines.zh: 我觉得这有点不公平吗?当然。但 Tsubasa 至少到目前为止,看起来是个好人。所以就算她没有生在富豪之家,我确信她走到今天也能闯出来。

lines.en: Once I arrive, I’m escorted through the gates by a group of servants and taken to meet Tsubasa in her usual water garden.
lines.zh: 一到那里,一群仆人便领我穿过大门,去她常待的水庭园见 Tsubasa。

lines.en: As always, her husband is nowhere to be found and I wind up hanging out with her while he’s off being inattentive and unintentionally abstinent.
lines.zh: 一如既往,她丈夫不见踪影,我便陪她消磨时光——而他则在外头心不在焉、无意识地禁欲。

lines.en: Tsubasa takes me inside and gives me another tour of her endless abode, once again packed with history of the Tsukioka family and where all of their various treasures have been imported from.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 带我进屋,又领我参观了一遍她那望不到头的宅邸——再一次塞满了 Tsukioka 家的历史,以及他们各种珍宝的进口来源。

lines.en: Along the way, she prods me for information about her daughter and how she’s doing in school.
lines.zh: 途中,她向我打探她女儿的消息,以及她在学校过得如何。

lines.en: She then tries to pawn her other daughter off on me. But I’m pretty sure that’s only because Tsubasa is a step or two away from making her disappear forever at this point.
lines.zh: 接着,她试着把另一个女儿塞给我。但我相当确定,这只是因为到了这一步,Tsubasa 离让她永远消失只差一两步了。

lines.en: Eventually, she takes me into the dining hall for a full-on buffet prepared by a team of world class chefs that will likely all be fired by a certain someone before nightfall.
lines.zh: 最后,她领我进餐厅,享用一支世界级厨师团队准备的全套自助餐——而入夜之前,这支团队多半会被某个人全部开除。

lines.en: Not really knowing how to approach this (Or even what the majority of the food is), I take a seat at the table and allow Tsubasa to choose my lunch for me.
lines.zh: 完全不知道该如何下手(甚至认不出大部分食物是什么),我在桌边坐下,任由 Tsubasa 替我挑选午餐。

lines.en: Before I know it, I have gorged myself to the point of being unable to walk anymore and need to be driven back home by her personal driver- but not before packing another box of rich person food for Ami to try.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间,我已经吃到走不动路,得由她的私人司机送我回家——但在此之前,还要再打包一盒有钱人食物,给 Ami 尝尝。
Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
